verses.original: עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בִּשְׁנַ֨ת לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בֶן־ אֲמַצְיָ֖ה מָלַ֛ךְ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘eś·rîm wā·še·ḇa‘ šā·nāh biš·naṯ lə·yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ‘ă·zar·yāh ḇen- ’ă·maṣ·yāh mā·laḵ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the twenty-seventh . . . . . . year of Jeroboam’s reign over Israel Azariah son of Amaziah became king . . . of Judah

verses.original: הָיָ֣ה שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה בֶּן־ שָׁנָה֙ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה אִמּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֣ם יְכָלְיָ֖הוּ מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yāh šêš ‘eś·rêh ben- šā·nāh ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh ’im·mōw wə·šêm yə·ḵā·lə·yā·hū mî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: He was sixteen . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two . . . years His mother’s name was Jecoliah she was from Jerusalem

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָבִֽיו׃ אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ עָשָׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ā·ḇîw ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And he did [what was] right in the eyes of the LORD just as - his father Amaziah had done

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ הָעָ֛ם ע֥וֹד מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: raq hab·bā·mō·wṯ lō- sā·rū hā·‘ām ‘ō·wḏ mə·zab·bə·ḥîm ū·mə·qaṭ·ṭə·rîm bab·bā·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Nevertheless the high places were not taken away the people continued sacrificing and burning incense [there]

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ וַיְנַגַּ֨ע הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיְהִ֤י מְצֹרָע֙ עַד־ י֣וֹם מֹת֔וֹ וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב הַחָפְשִׁ֑ית בְּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ בֶּן־ וְיוֹתָ֤ם עַל־ הַבַּ֔יִת שֹׁפֵ֖ט אֶת־ עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·nag·ga‘ ham·me·leḵ way·hî mə·ṣō·rā‘ ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·ṯōw way·yê·šeḇ ha·ḥā·p̄ə·šîṯ bə·ḇêṯ ham·me·leḵ ben- wə·yō·w·ṯām ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ šō·p̄êṭ ’eṯ- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And the LORD - afflicted the king . . . with leprosy until the day he died so that he lived in a separate house while [his] son Jotham had charge of the palace and governed - the people of the land

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י עֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ‘ă·zar·yā·hū wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Azariah along with all his accomplishments . . . . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah

verses.original: עֲזַרְיָה֙ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד בְּנ֖וֹ יוֹתָ֥ם וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·zar·yāh way·yiš·kaḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ bə·nōw yō·w·ṯām way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Azariah rested with his fathers and was buried - near [them] in the City of David And his son Jotham reigned in his place

verses.original: שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּשְׁמֹנֶה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בִּשְׁנַ֨ת לַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה זְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יָרָבְעָ֧ם מָ֠לַךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן שִׁשָּׁ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·mō·neh šā·nāh biš·naṯ la·‘ă·zar·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh zə·ḵar·yā·hū ḇen- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn šiš·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: In the thirty-eighth . . . . . . year of Azariah’s reign over Judah Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel [and he reigned] in Samaria six months

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲבֹתָ֑יו עָשׂ֖וּ לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵֽחַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw ‘ā·śū lō sār mê·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer yiś·rā·’êl he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ-
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD as his fathers had done He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat - had caused Israel to commit -

verses.original: שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן־ יָבֵ֔שׁ וַיִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָיו֙ וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ קָֽבָלְ־ עָ֖ם וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šal·lum ben- yā·ḇêš way·yiq·šōr ‘ā·lāw way·yak·kê·hū way·mî·ṯê·hū qā·ḇā·lə·‘ām ‘am way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Then Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah struck him down and killed him in front of the people and reigned in his place

verses.original: וְיֶ֖תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê zə·ḵar·yāh hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Zechariah they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel

verses.original: ה֣וּא דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר אֶל־ יֵהוּא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃פ רְבִיעִ֔ים בְּנֵ֣י לְךָ֖ יֵשְׁב֥וּ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
verses.transliteration: hū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber ’el- yê·hū lê·mōr way·hî- ḵên rə·ḇî·‘îm bə·nê lə·ḵā yê·šə·ḇū ‘al- kis·sê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: - So the word of the LORD - spoken to Jehu . . . was fulfilled Four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel

verses.original: שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בִּשְׁנַ֨ת לְעֻזִיָּ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה שַׁלּ֤וּם בֶּן־ יָבֵישׁ֙ מָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃ יֶֽרַח־ יָמִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ šā·nāh biš·naṯ lə·‘u·zî·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh šal·lūm ben- yā·ḇêš mā·laḵ way·yim·lōḵ bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ye·raḥ- yā·mîm
verses.literal: In the thirty-ninth . . . . . . year of Uzziah’s reign over Judah Shallum son of Jabesh became king and he reigned in Samaria one full month . . .

verses.original: מְנַחֵ֨ם בֶּן־ גָּדִ֜י וַיַּעַל֩ מִתִּרְצָ֗ה וַיָּבֹא֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַיַּ֛ךְ אֶת־ וַיְמִיתֵ֖הוּ שַׁלּ֥וּם בֶּן־ יָבֵ֖ישׁ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: mə·na·ḥêm ben- gā·ḏî way·ya·‘al mit·tir·ṣāh way·yā·ḇō šō·mə·rō·wn way·yaḵ ’eṯ- way·mî·ṯê·hū šal·lūm ben- yā·ḇêš bə·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Then Menahem son of Gadi went up from Tirzah . . . to Samaria struck down - and killed Shallum son of Jabesh - and reigned in his place

verses.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י שַׁלּ֔וּם וְקִשְׁר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָשָׁ֑ר הִנָּ֣ם כְּתֻבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê šal·lūm wə·qiš·rōw ’ă·šer qā·šār hin·nām kə·ṯu·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Shallum along with the conspiracy - he led they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel

verses.original: אָ֣ז מְ֠נַחֵם אֶת־ מִתִּרְצָ֔ה יַכֶּֽה־ תִּפְסַ֨ח וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤הּ וְאֶת־ גְּבוּלֶ֙יהָ֙ כִּ֛י לֹ֥א פָתַ֖ח וַיַּ֑ךְ אֵ֛ת בִּקֵּֽעַ׃פ כָּל־ הֶהָ֥רוֹתֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: ’āz mə·na·ḥêm ’eṯ- mit·tir·ṣāh yak·keh- tip̄·saḥ wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- bāh wə·’eṯ- gə·ḇū·le·hā kî lō p̄ā·ṯaḥ way·yaḵ ’êṯ biq·qê·a‘ kāl- he·hā·rō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: At that time Menahem - starting from Tirzah attacked Tiphsah and everyone in its - vicinity because they would not open [their gates] So he attacked [Tiphsah] - and ripped open all the pregnant women

verses.original: שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מְנַחֵ֨ם בֶּן־ גָּדִ֧י מָ֠לַךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃ עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ biš·naṯ šā·nāh la·‘ă·zar·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mə·na·ḥêm ben- gā·ḏî mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ‘e·śer šā·nîm
verses.literal: In the thirty-ninth . . . year of Azariah’s reign over Judah Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel [and he reigned] in Samaria ten years

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כָּל־ יָמָֽיו׃ לֹ֣א סָ֠ר מֵעַ֨ל חַטֹּ֜אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kāl- yā·māw lō sār mê·‘al ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer- yiś·rā·’êl he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ-
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and throughout his reign he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat - had caused Israel to commit -

verses.original: פ֤וּל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ בָּ֣א עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מְנַחֵם֙ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן לְפ֔וּל אֶ֖לֶף כִּכַּר־ כָּ֑סֶף לִהְי֤וֹת יָדָיו֙ אִתּ֔וֹ לְהַחֲזִ֥יק בְּיָדֽוֹ׃ הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: p̄ūl me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr bā ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ mə·na·ḥêm way·yit·tên lə·p̄ūl ’e·lep̄ kik·kar- kā·sep̄ lih·yō·wṯ yā·ḏāw ’it·tōw lə·ha·ḥă·zîq bə·yā·ḏōw ham·mam·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded . . . the land and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver in order to gain his support . . . . . . and strengthen his own grip on the kingdom

verses.original: מְנַחֵ֨ם אֶת־ וַיֹּצֵא֩ הַכֶּ֜סֶף עַל־ עַ֚ל כָּל־ הַחַ֔יִל גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל חֲמִשִּׁ֧ים שְׁקָלִ֛ים כֶּ֖סֶף אֶחָ֑ד לְאִ֣ישׁ לָתֵת֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ וְלֹא־ עָ֥מַד שָׁ֖ם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·na·ḥêm ’eṯ- way·yō·ṣê hak·ke·sep̄ ‘al- ‘al kāl- ha·ḥa·yil gib·bō·w·rê yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·miš·šîm šə·qā·lîm ke·sep̄ ’e·ḥāḏ lə·’îš lā·ṯêṯ lə·me·leḵ ’aš·šūr me·leḵ ’aš·šūr way·yā·šāḇ wə·lō- ‘ā·maḏ šām bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Menahem exacted this money from . . . each of the wealthy men of Israel fifty shekels of silver from each man to give to the king of Assyria So the king of Assyria withdrew and did not remain . . . in the land

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י מְנַחֵ֖ם וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê mə·na·ḥêm wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Menahem along with all his accomplishments . . . . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel

verses.original: מְנַחֵ֖ם וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו בְנ֖וֹ פְּקַחְיָ֥ה וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: mə·na·ḥêm way·yiš·kaḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw ḇə·nōw pə·qaḥ·yāh way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Menahem rested with his fathers and his son Pekahiah reigned in his place

verses.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בִּשְׁנַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה פְּקַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶן־ מְנַחֵ֧ם מָ֠לַךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·miš·šîm biš·naṯ šā·nāh la·‘ă·zar·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh pə·qaḥ·yāh ḇen- mə·na·ḥêm mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn šə·nā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: In the fiftieth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel and reigned in Samaria two years

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵֽחַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lō sār mê·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer yiś·rā·’êl he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ-
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat - had caused Israel to commit -

verses.original: שָׁלִישׁ֗וֹ פֶּ֨קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֜הוּ וַיִּקְשֹׁ֣ר עָלָיו֩ אֶת־ אַרְגֹּ֣ב וְאֶת־ הָאַרְיֵ֔ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָדִ֑ים בְּאַרְמ֤וֹן מֶלֶךְ בֵּית־ בְשֹׁמְר֜וֹן וַיַּכֵּ֨הוּ וַיְמִיתֵ֖הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lî·šōw pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū way·yiq·šōr ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- ’ar·gōḇ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·yêh wə·‘im·mōw ḥă·miš·šîm ’îš mib·bə·nê ḡil·‘ā·ḏîm bə·’ar·mō·wn mɛ·lɛḵ bêṯ- ḇə·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yak·kê·hū way·mî·ṯê·hū way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Then his officer Pekah son of Remaliah conspired against him along with Argob . . . Arieh and fifty men of Gilead And at the citadel of the king’s palace in Samaria [Pekah] struck down and killed [Pekahiah] and reigned in his place

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י פְקַחְיָ֖ה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê p̄ə·qaḥ·yāh wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Pekahiah along with all his accomplishments . . . they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel

verses.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה פֶּ֣קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֧הוּ מָ֠לַךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·ta·yim biš·naṯ šā·nāh la·‘ă·zar·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: In the fifty-second . . . year of Azariah’s reign over Judah Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel [and he reigned] in Samaria twenty years

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִן־ חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lō sār min- ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer yiś·rā·’êl he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ-
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat - had caused Israel to commit -

verses.original: בִּימֵ֞י פֶּ֣קַח מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל תִּגְלַ֣ת פִּלְאֶסֶר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֒ בָּא֮ וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ עִיּ֡וֹן וְאֶת־ אָבֵ֣ל בֵּֽית־ מַעֲכָ֡ה וְאֶת־ יָ֠נוֹחַ וְאֶת־ קֶ֨דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ חָצ֤וֹר וְאֶת־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְאֶת־ הַגָּלִ֔ילָה כֹּ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ נַפְתָּלִ֑י וַיַּגְלֵ֖ם אַשּֽׁוּרָה׃
verses.transliteration: bî·mê pe·qaḥ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl tiḡ·laṯ pil·’e·ser me·leḵ ’aš·šūr bā way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ‘î·yō·wn wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ḇêl bêṯ- ma·‘ă·ḵāh wə·’eṯ- yā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’eṯ- qe·ḏeš wə·’eṯ- ḥā·ṣō·wr wə·’eṯ- hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·’eṯ- hag·gā·lî·lāh kōl ’e·reṣ nap̄·tā·lî way·yaḡ·lêm ’aš·šū·rāh
verses.literal: In the days of Pekah king of Israel vvv Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came and captured - Ijon - vvv vvv Abel-beth-maacah - Janoah - Kedesh - Hazor - Gilead - and Galilee including all the land of Naphtali and he took the people as captives to Assyria

verses.original: הוֹשֵׁ֣עַ בֶּן־ אֵלָ֗ה וַיִּקְשָׁר־ קֶ֜שֶׁר עַל־ פֶּ֙קַח֙ בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֔הוּ עֶשְׂרִ֔ים בִּשְׁנַ֣ת לְיוֹתָ֖ם בֶּן־ עֻזִיָּֽה׃ וַיַּכֵּ֙הוּ֙ וַיְמִיתֵ֔הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑יו
verses.transliteration: hō·wō·šê·a‘ ben- ’ê·lāh way·yiq·šār- qe·šer ‘al- pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū ‘eś·rîm biš·naṯ lə·yō·w·ṯām ben- ‘u·zî·yāh way·yak·kê·hū way·mî·ṯê·hū way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Then Hoshea son of Elah led a conspiracy against Pekah son of Remaliah In the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah [Hoshea] attacked [Pekah] killed him and reigned in his place

verses.original: וְיֶ֥תֶר דִּבְרֵי־ פֶ֖קַח וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê- p̄e·qaḥ wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Pekah along with all his accomplishments . . . they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel

verses.original: שְׁתַּ֔יִם בִּשְׁנַ֣ת מֶ֣לֶךְ לְפֶ֥קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֖הוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יוֹתָ֥ם בֶּן־ עֻזִיָּ֖הוּ מָלַ֛ךְ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ta·yim biš·naṯ me·leḵ lə·p̄e·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū yiś·rā·’êl yō·w·ṯām ben- ‘u·zî·yā·hū mā·laḵ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the second year of the reign of Pekah son of Remaliah over Israel Jotham son of Uzziah became king . . . of Judah

verses.original: הָיָ֣ה עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בֶּן־ שָׁנָה֙ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה אִמּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֣ם יְרוּשָׁ֖א בַּת־ צָדֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yāh ‘eś·rîm wə·ḥā·mêš ben- šā·nāh ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêš- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ’im·mōw wə·šêm yə·rū·šā baṯ- ṣā·ḏō·wq
verses.literal: He was twenty-five . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen . . . years His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָבִ֖יו עָשָֽׂה׃ עֻזִיָּ֥הוּ עָשָׂ֛ה
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ā·ḇîw ‘ā·śāh ‘u·zî·yā·hū ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And he did [what was] right in the eyes of the LORD just as - his father . . . Uzziah had done

verses.original: רַ֤ק הַבָּמוֹת֙ לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ הָעָ֛ם ע֗וֹד מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמ֑וֹת ה֗וּא בָּנָ֛ה אֶת־ הָעֶלְיֽוֹן׃ שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: raq hab·bā·mō·wṯ lō sā·rū hā·‘ām ‘ō·wḏ mə·zab·bə·ḥîm ū·mə·qaṭ·ṭə·rîm bab·bā·mō·wṯ hū bā·nāh ’eṯ- hā·‘el·yō·wn ša·‘ar bêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Nevertheless the high places were not taken away the people continued sacrificing and burning incense [there] Jotham rebuilt - the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֵ֣ם הֲלֹא־ כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hêm hă·lō- kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jotham along with his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah

verses.original: הָהֵ֔ם בַּיָּמִ֣ים יְהוָ֗ה הֵחֵ֣ל לְהַשְׁלִ֙יחַ֙ רְצִ֖ין מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וְאֵ֖ת פֶּ֥קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: hā·hêm bay·yā·mîm Yah·weh hê·ḥêl lə·haš·lî·aḥ rə·ṣîn me·leḵ ’ă·rām wə·’êṯ pe·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū bî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In those days the LORD began to send Rezin king of Aram - and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah

verses.original: יוֹתָם֙ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו בְּעִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו בְּנ֖וֹ אָחָ֥ז וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ṯām way·yiš·kaḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw bə·nōw ’ā·ḥāz way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried with [them] in the City of David his father And his son Ahaz reigned in his place
